title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 4th Season
content:
Season 3 might have been forever dubbed to “The Last Time I snoozed Under the Coffee Table”, this season might have been the dream my brain was experiencing then and there. A colossal rave that oozes the same wave of hype as that of season 2.

This season was enough to CPR the fall off that the series suffered from the last season. It got so many things right on track. For starters, we are acting on something instead of committing a 9-5 zoom call. We got politics, fights, conflict, betrayals, extortion and mind bending plot twists all on a cohesive package. And what might be the best opening song and sequence in the franchise too. And let’s not forget the Mariabell-themed ending song.

What puts this season above the rest in my opinion was that we finally got answers and revelations about a very brought-up and mysterious topic that has been strongly present in conversations and in-verse since season 1. I will spare you the spoilers, but the series has grown bigger in retrospect because of it. And how everything is tied-in together is very satisfying.

For anyone who has given up on the show due to season 3, I really urge you to slog through and then watch this one. It is the saving grace this show has, and with it, it elevated even more as an Isekai.

Overall: 8.34/10.
